board.note: Point = (col,row), 0<=col<13 wraps (col 12 adjacent to col 0), 0<=row<13 has edges (row 0 = top, row 12 = bottom). Orthogonal adjacency only.

moves.placement: Place one stone of your color on an empty point. Passing is ILLEGAL.
moves.capture: After placement, any opponent group (orthogonally connected, with column wrap) with zero liberties is removed.
moves.suicide: ILLEGAL: after resolving captures, your own placed group must have >= 1 liberty.
moves.superko: Positional superko: a move may not recreate ANY previous full-board stone configuration (color-to-move independent).

terminal.win_by_connection: Immediately after your move, if any of YOUR orthogonally-connected groups touches BOTH row 0 and row 12, you win.
terminal.no_legal_move: A player with no legal move loses.

ply_cap.rule: If ply 600 completes with no winner, the player with MORE stones on the board wins; ties go to White. Draws are impossible.

openings.note: The first 6 plies are dictated by the harness from a hidden balanced pool; neither side chooses them. They are revealed to you via the 'opening' prefix on your first move command.

symmetry_group.structure: C13 |x (C2 x C2); color swap is NOT a symmetry
symmetry_group.note: Disclosed so neither side holds a hidden invariance. A column-circular-conv network is exactly equivariant to the 13 shifts.

match.adjudication: illegal move / malformed reply / crash / clock or memory violation = loss of that game
